program: Medical College of Georgia / Augusta University (Heme-Onc)

The Notion Henry Ford Providence page lists the stipend scale effective 7/1/2026: PGY4 $76,367, PGY5 $78,729, PGY6 $81,865. SalaryDr (a third-party aggregator) gives the same PGY-4 2026-27 figure. Henry Ford's own page wasn't reached. Extras: $1,500/yr meal stipend loaded onto the badge, $1,650/yr education allowance (PGY3+), $2,000/yr research fund (program), up to $1,500 travel funding, 403(b) match up to 3.5%.

institution: LSU Health Sciences Center New Orleans GME
